newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA obtains EIB loan for motor production.
newsitem.headline: PSA obtains EIB loan for motor production.

text.p: French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen has obtained a 1.3 billion franc ($228.2 million) European Investment Bank loan to build a new generation of engines in the northeastern French town of Tremery, the EIB and the Peugeot group said on Thursday.
They said the loan, for 200.2 million ecus, would help finance production of petrol and direct-injection diesel engines using common-rail technology at the Ennery site in Tremery.
"Compared with current direct-injection diesel fuel engines, this new technology represents a real advance in terms of protecting the environment and performance," the EIB said in a statement.
It would also reduce fuel consumption by 10-15 percent and lower emissions considerably, the statement said.
The production capacity of Ennery, located in a European regional development zone in France's rust belt, should reach 6,000 engines daily.
The investment will be carried out by Societe Mecanique Automobile de l'Est, owned jointly by Automobiles Peugeot and Automobiles Citroen, the PSA group's carmaking divisions.
